description: BISSELL hand vacuums are always on call for quick cleanups of everyday messes on floors and above floor surfaces. Plus, some even come with innovative pet-hair features to quickly cleanup pet hair from your furry friends.

The Pet Hair Eraser Cordless Hand vacuum is designed to be ready to go as soon as a mess arises. But if the vacuum is buried in a closet or doesn’t make it back on its charger in between uses, it may not be ready when you need it. That’s why the Pet Hair Eraser comes with a charger that you can mount to your wall using a few screws, so you can grab and go as soon as you notice the mess. Choose a place where messes occur often and where there is a wall outlet close by.Having a cordless hand vacuum with a wall charger also means that you won’t have to unwind and rewind a power cord, making your cleaning process even faster and easier.
Does the Amps mean greater cleaning ability?

No. Amps is a measurement of the electrical current used by the motor. Performance depends on a combination of (A) airflow/suction plus (B) brush action to provide (C) cleaning. Therefore, an easy way to remember what is important for good cleaning performance is “A + B = C™”. Some manufacturers focus on only A or B, BISSELL, however, realizes the importance of both.
You love your pet. But you don’t have to love the mess. That’s why BISSELL has special pet cleaning products that give you solutions for stains and odors, pet shedding, and accidents

This handheld vacuum delivers the strong suction needed for fast results. In addition to being powerful, the Pet Hair Eraser includes a rubberized nozzle that helps to pull out pet hair found on furniture, stairs, pet beds and other areas that hair collects. It is also convenient for clean up around food bowls and litter boxes.
The Bissell Pet Hair Eraser is cordless, which allows you the freedom to clean up without the hassle of a cord across all surfaces: stairs, edges, furniture and more
